raw_response:
I farm only 8 mu, so I cannot play big games. I do what has worked on my land and what I can afford. Wheat and maize together are my safe way. If one side goes badly, the other still brings something back. I have a well, so I will use water, but not too many times because pumping costs money. I cannot read much, so I do not count like the technicians. I look at the field, the color of the crop, and what the neighbors do. For wheat, I will still put a decent base fertilizer and then add some urea later if the crop looks weak, because if wheat is hungry in spring, yield drops fast. For maize, the time after wheat harvest is short, so I will keep it simple: harvest wheat, quickly rotary till once, sow maize fast, use hybrid seed, and topdress once when it grows up. I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than let the crop go yellow, but I still have to keep some cash in hand because people in the family work outside and farm labor at home is not always enough.
